```{R}  

DATA_DIR  <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/cleaned_dat"
RAW_DIR04 <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/raw/raw_dat_20260418"

# baseline
dat_bl <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "merged_baseline_wDemo.csv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(dx %in% c("EOAD", "EOnonAD")) %>%
  mutate(log_ptau217 = log(ptau217))

eoad_ids <- dat_bl %>%
  filter(dx == "EOAD") %>%
  pull(subject_label)

# helpers
exclude_tx <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(tx_started == 0) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("tx_start_date", "tx_started")))
}

filter_longitudinal <- function(df, eoad_ids, id_col = "subject_label") {
  df %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% eoad_ids) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
    filter(n() >= 2) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# longitudinal files
ptau_final <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "ptau_cleaned_20260418.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  exclude_tx() %>%
  filter_longitudinal(eoad_ids) %>%
  mutate(log_ptau217 = log(ptau217))

tau_final <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "tau_cleaned_20260418.csv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  exclude_tx() %>%
  filter_longitudinal(eoad_ids)

amy_final <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "amy_cleaned_20260418.csv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  exclude_tx() %>%
  filter_longitudinal(eoad_ids)

cdr_final <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "cdr_cleaned_20260418.csv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  exclude_tx() %>%
  filter_longitudinal(eoad_ids)

moca_final <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "moca_cleaned_20260418.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  exclude_tx() %>%
  filter_longitudinal(eoad_ids)

# optional: inspect shapes
map(list(dat_bl = dat_bl,
         ptau_final = ptau_final,
         tau_final = tau_final,
         amy_final = amy_final,
         cdr_final = cdr_final,
         moca_final = moca_final), nrow)
```


```{r}
 

# models fit on their own data frames
tau_mod <- lmer(
  desikan_suvr ~ year_to_baseline_tau + (1 | subject_label),
  data = tau_final,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

ptau_mod <- lmer(
  log_ptau217 ~ year_to_baseline_ptau + (1 | subject_label),
  data = ptau_final,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

amy_mod <- lmer(
  centiloid_wcbl ~ year_to_baseline_amy + (1 | subject_label),
  data = amy_final,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

# helper: marginal predictions + 95% CI from fixed effects
make_pred <- function(mod, term, biomarker, n = 200) {
  pred <- ggpredict(mod, terms = sprintf("%s [n=%d]", term, n))

  as.data.frame(pred) %>%
    transmute(
      time = x,
      fit  = predicted,
      lwr  = conf.low,
      upr  = conf.high,
      biomarker = biomarker
    )
}
cdr_mod <- lmer(
  cdrsb ~ year_to_baseline_cdr + (1 | subject_label),
  data = cdr_final,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

moca_mod <- lmer(
  moca ~ year_to_baseline_moca + (1 | subject_label),
  data = moca_final,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)
# predictions from each marker-specific dataframe/model
pred_ptau <- make_pred(ptau_mod, "year_to_baseline_ptau", "p-tau217")
pred_amy  <- make_pred(amy_mod,  "year_to_baseline_amy",  "Centiloid")
pred_tau  <- make_pred(tau_mod,  "year_to_baseline_tau",  "Tau PET")
pred_cdr  <- make_pred(cdr_mod,  "year_to_baseline_cdr",  "CDR")
pred_moca <- make_pred(moca_mod, "year_to_baseline_moca", "MoCA")

pred_all <- bind_rows(
  pred_ptau, pred_amy, pred_tau,
  pred_cdr, pred_moca
) %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker = factor(
      biomarker,
      levels = c("p-tau217", "Centiloid", "Tau PET", "CDR", "MoCA")
    )
  )
 
 
```




```{r} 

summarize_lmm <- function(mod, term, label) {
  # standardized coefficients
  std <- parameters::standardize_parameters(mod, verbose = FALSE) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  std_col <- grep("^Std_", names(std), value = TRUE)[1]

  beta <- std %>%
    filter(.data$Parameter == term) %>%
    pull(all_of(std_col)) %>%
    as.numeric()

  # p-value from lmerTest summary
  pval <- coef(summary(mod))[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]

  # R2
  r2 <- performance::r2_nakagawa(mod, verbose = FALSE)

  cat("\n", label, "\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("standardized coefficient: %.3f\n", beta))
  cat(sprintf("p-value: %.4f\n", pval))
  cat(sprintf("marginal R2: %.3f\n", r2$R2_marginal))
  cat(sprintf("conditional R2: %.3f\n", r2$R2_conditional))

  invisible(list(
    beta = beta,
    pval = pval,
    r2_marginal = r2$R2_marginal,
    r2_conditional = r2$R2_conditional
  ))
}



```


```{r}

# run for all models
# run for all models
summarize_lmm(tau_mod,  "year_to_baseline_tau",  "cortical FTP PET")
summarize_lmm(ptau_mod, "year_to_baseline_ptau", "log p-tau217")
summarize_lmm(amy_mod,  "year_to_baseline_amy",  "Centiloid")
summarize_lmm(cdr_mod,  "year_to_baseline_cdr",  "CDRSB")
summarize_lmm(moca_mod, "year_to_baseline_moca", "MoCA")
